dev_claude.title: What Claude is doing
dev_claude.intro: Read from this computer's files every few seconds while this panel is open. It only reads: it changes nothing.
dev_claude.no_checkout: This copy of HumanityOS is not running from the source folder (the one holding Cargo.toml and data/coordination), so there is nothing here to read. Start it from the checkout, or from target/release inside it.
dev_claude.worktrees_hint: Each Claude agent works in a folder of its own under .claude/worktrees. The main checkout first, then the newest commit first.
dev_claude.held_gone: held by an agent that has stopped
dev_claude.tier0: Next up: the top of TIER 0
dev_claude.tier0_hint: The headings under TIER 0 in docs/PRIORITIES.md, in order.
dev_claude.ahead: this checkout is ahead of it
dev_claude.delivered: delivered: it holds this tree's code (v{{v}})
dev_claude.delivered_trailing: delivered: it holds this tree's code; its title bar reads v{{v}}, from before a docs-only version bump
dev_claude.not_delivered: not delivered: target/release holds this code and the taskbar exe does not ({{n}} files differ, first {{first}}). just deliver fixes it
dev_claude.not_built: not built: {{n}} compiled-in files differ from what the taskbar exe was built from (first {{first}}), and target/release does not hold them either
dev_claude.taskbar_missing: not delivered: there is no HumanityOS.exe in the checkout
dev_claude.taskbar_no_stamp: unknown: HumanityOS.exe carries no source fingerprint, so what code it holds cannot be told
dev_claude.built_stale: target/release does not hold this tree's code either
dev_claude.delivery_hint: The taskbar line compares each exe's built-in source fingerprint with the files on disk, as just check-delivery does.
dev_claude.share_running: running: last pass {{ago}}, {{n}} development processes held at below-normal priority, {{kept}} of {{logical}} processors kept for you
dev_claude.share_stopped: not running: its last pass was {{ago}}
dev_claude.share_never: not running: it has never run on this computer (just install-share-guard)
dev_claude.disk_ran: ran {{ago}}: {{what}}. C: was {{pct}}% used, {{free}} GB free
dev_claude.disk_late: last ran {{ago}}, over three hours ago: is its task installed? (just install-disk-guard). That pass: {{what}}
dev_claude.disk_never: it has never run on this computer (just install-disk-guard)
dev_claude.lock_free: free: no rig is booting the game
dev_claude.lock_stale: left behind by {{rig}} (pid {{pid}}), which has stopped; the next rig takes it over
dev_claude.lock_unreadable: a rig is writing it, or it is damaged
dev_claude.read_times: Last read: files {{files}}, git {{git}}, exe checks {{delivery}}, GitHub {{github}}.
dev_claude.git_missing: git is not installed or not on PATH, so the worktrees cannot be listed.
dev_claude.web_pc_only: Worktrees, uncommitted changes, the agents' handoff notes, the taskbar exe, the share guard, the disk guard, the boot lock and the build slot live on the developer's computer, which a website cannot read. The desktop app shows them in Dev > Claude.
dev_claude.web_journal_hint: The newest three entries of the journal as of the website's last update (the copy of data/coordination/orchestrator_state.json this site serves).
dev_claude.web_tier0_hint: The headings under TIER 0 in GitHub's copy of docs/PRIORITIES.md.
dev_claude.web_release_hint: The newest release on GitHub, and the newest commit on main.
dev_claude.notes_hint: What each agent last wrote down about its work (done, verified, next): .claude/handoff/*.md in the checkout and in each worktree, newest first.
dev_claude.slot_none: not set up on this computer (just build-slot)
dev_claude.slot_summary: {{compiling}} compiling, {{waiting}} waiting their turn for memory
dev_claude.slot_compiling: compiling {{crate}} ({{kind}}) in {{place}}, up to {{gb}} GB, started {{ago}}
